## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes possible. Link the relevant issue when available.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Explain any checks not completed.

- [ ] Relevant backend tests, frontend interaction tests, and production build pass (`pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/check.ps1` for the full check).
- [ ] Visible changes have been checked in a real browser, including both languages/themes and a narrow viewport where relevant.
- [ ] Calculation, execution, bridge, or export changes reconcile fixed inputs, outputs, ledger entries, and evidence; methodology updates are included where needed.
- [ ] The diff, logs, and screenshots contain no personal caches, research records, notes, vault settings, original attachments, credentials, or machine-specific paths.

Mark checks that do not apply and explain why. Add sanitized screenshots or synthetic reproduction details when they help a reviewer verify the behavior.
